# Heading anchors and implicit references

```````````````````````````````` example
# My Header

A paragraph.
.
Document scope=1:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Heading scope=1:1..1:11 anchor="my-header" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:3..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="My Header" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=3:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="A paragraph." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
# My Header

## My Header
.
Document scope=1:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Heading scope=1:1..1:11 anchor="my-header" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:3..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="My Header" children=0
└── Heading scope=3:1..3:12 anchor="my-header-1" attributes={} level=2 children=1
    └── Text scope=3:4..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="My Header" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
# T {#x}

# x
.
Document scope=1:1..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Heading scope=1:1..1:8 anchor="x" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="T" children=0
└── Heading scope=3:1..3:3 anchor="x-1" attributes={} level=1 children=1
    └── Text scope=3:3..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
# Hello, World!

# 1. Intro

# A.B

# :tada: Party

# *Em* and `code`

# !!!

# Ünïcode Ĝ

#   spaced   words
.
Document scope=1:1..15:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=8
├── Heading scope=1:1..1:15 anchor="hello-world" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:3..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Hello, World!" children=0
├── Heading scope=3:1..3:10 anchor="1-intro" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=3:3..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="1. Intro" children=0
├── Heading scope=5:1..5:5 anchor="ab" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=5:3..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="A.B" children=0
├── Heading scope=7:1..7:14 anchor="tada-party" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=7:3..7:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal=":tada: Party" children=0
├── Heading scope=9:1..9:17 anchor="em-and-code" attributes={} level=1 children=3
│   ├── Emphasis scope=9:3..9:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=9:4..9:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Em" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=9:7..9:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" and " children=0
│   └── Code scope=9:12..9:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="code" children=0
├── Heading scope=11:1..11:5 anchor="section" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=11:3..11:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="!!!" children=0
├── Heading scope=13:1..13:14 anchor="ünïcode-ĝ" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=13:3..13:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Ünïcode Ĝ" children=0
└── Heading scope=15:1..15:18 anchor="spaced---words" attributes={} level=1 children=1
    └── Text scope=15:5..15:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal="spaced   words" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
# First chapter

[First chapter] [First chapter][] [go there][First chapter]
.
Document scope=1:1..3:59 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Heading scope=1:1..1:15 anchor="first-chapter" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:3..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="First chapter" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:59 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Link scope=3:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("#first-chapter") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=3:2..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="First chapter" children=0
    ├── Text scope=3:16..3:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Link scope=3:17..3:33 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("#first-chapter") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=3:18..3:30 anchor=null attributes={} literal="First chapter" children=0
    ├── Text scope=3:34..3:34 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Link scope=3:35..3:59 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("#first-chapter") title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=3:36..3:43 anchor=null attributes={} literal="go there" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
# First chapter

[First chapter]

[First chapter]: /explicit
.
Document scope=1:1..5:26 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Heading scope=1:1..1:15 anchor="first-chapter" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:3..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="First chapter" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Link scope=3:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("/explicit") title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=3:2..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="First chapter" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
# *Foo*

[*Foo*] [Foo]
.
Document scope=1:1..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Heading scope=1:1..1:7 anchor="foo" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Emphasis scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:4..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Foo" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Link scope=3:1..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("#foo") title=null children=1
    │   └── Emphasis scope=3:2..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=3:3..3:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Foo" children=0
    └── Text scope=3:8..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" [Foo]" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
# Dup

# Dup

[Dup]
.
Document scope=1:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── Heading scope=1:1..1:5 anchor="dup" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:3..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Dup" children=0
├── Heading scope=3:1..3:5 anchor="dup-1" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=3:3..3:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Dup" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Link scope=5:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("#dup") title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=5:2..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Dup" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
# My Header

[[#My Header]]
.
Document scope=1:1..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Heading scope=1:1..1:11 anchor="my-header" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:3..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="My Header" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── CrossLink scope=3:1..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} dest=cross(path="",anchor="My Header") label=null children=0
````````````````````````````````

## formatting

```````````````````````````````` example
# **Strong** *Em* ~~Strike~~ ==Mark== ++Insert++
.
Document scope=1:1..1:48 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Heading scope=1:1..1:48 anchor="strong-em-strike-mark-insert" attributes={} level=1 children=9
    ├── Strong scope=1:3..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:5..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Strong" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:13..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Emphasis scope=1:14..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:15..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Em" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:18..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Strikethrough scope=1:19..1:28 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:21..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Strike" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:29..1:29 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Mark scope=1:30..1:37 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:32..1:35 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Mark" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:38..1:38 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Insertion scope=1:39..1:48 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:41..1:46 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Insert" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## links and media

```````````````````````````````` example
# [Label](/url) ![Alt *Text*](/img) <https://Example.com/X>
.
Document scope=1:1..1:59 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Heading scope=1:1..1:59 anchor="label-alt-text-httpsexamplecomx" attributes={} level=1 children=5
    ├── Link scope=1:3..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("/url") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:4..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Label" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:16..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Embedded scope=1:17..1:35 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("/img") title=null dimensions=null children=2
    │   ├── Text scope=1:19..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Alt " children=0
    │   └── Emphasis scope=1:23..1:28 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:24..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Text" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:36..1:36 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Link scope=1:37..1:59 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("https://Example.com/X") title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=1:38..1:58 anchor=null attributes={} literal="https://Example.com/X" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## formula and opaque omissions

```````````````````````````````` example
# $A+B$ <i>Visible</i> <!--hidden--> %%hide%% [^f]

[^f]: omitted
.
Document scope=1:1..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Heading scope=1:1..1:50 anchor="ab-visible---" attributes={} level=1 children=11
│   ├── Formula scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} mode=embedded literal="A+B" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:8..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── HTML scope=1:9..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="<i>" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:12..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Visible" children=0
│   ├── HTML scope=1:19..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal="</i>" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:23..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Comment scope=1:24..1:36 anchor=null attributes={} literal="hidden" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:37..1:37 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Comment scope=1:38..1:45 anchor=null attributes={} literal="hide" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:46..1:46 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:47..1:50 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:48..1:49 referent=footnote(id="f") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..3:13 id="f" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=3:7..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="omitted" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## soft and hard breaks

```````````````````````````````` example
One
Two  
Three\
Four
====
.
Document scope=1:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Heading scope=1:1..5:4 anchor="one-two-three-four" attributes={} level=1 children=7
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="One" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:4..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=2:1..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Two" children=0
    ├── LineBreak scope=2:6..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=3:1..3:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Three" children=0
    ├── LineBreak scope=3:6..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=4:1..4:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Four" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## cross links and embeds

```````````````````````````````` example
# [[Note Name#Heading!]] ![[Pic#Anchor|Label]] [[#Only]] [[N|]] ![[N#A]]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:72 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Heading scope=1:1..1:72 anchor="note-nameheading-label-only--na" attributes={} level=1 children=9
    ├── CrossLink scope=1:3..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} dest=cross(path="Note Name",anchor="Heading!") label=null children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:25..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── CrossEmbedded scope=1:26..1:46 anchor=null attributes={} dest=cross(path="Pic",anchor="Anchor") label="Label" dimensions=null children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:47..1:47 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── CrossLink scope=1:48..1:56 anchor=null attributes={} dest=cross(path="",anchor="Only") label=null children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:57..1:57 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── CrossLink scope=1:58..1:63 anchor=null attributes={} dest=cross(path="N",anchor=null) label="" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:64..1:64 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── CrossEmbedded scope=1:65..1:72 anchor=null attributes={} dest=cross(path="N",anchor="A") label=null dimensions=null children=0
````````````````````````````````

## directive field nesting

```````````````````````````````` example
# :n[One :m[Two] Three] End
.
Document scope=1:1..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Heading scope=1:1..1:27 anchor="one-two-three-end" attributes={} level=1 children=2
    ├── Directive scope=1:3..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} name="n" children=0
    │   └── DirectiveLabel scope=1:5..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    │       ├── Text scope=1:6..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="One " children=0
    │       ├── Directive scope=1:10..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} name="m" children=0
    │       │   └── DirectiveLabel scope=1:12..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       │       └── Text scope=1:13..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Two" children=0
    │       └── Text scope=1:17..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" Three" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:24..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" End" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Unicode simple lowercase and categories

```````````````````````````````` example
# İ ſ ẞ Σ ς Ⅳ ² é a‿b a⁀b _ A—B 😀
.
Document scope=1:1..1:53 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Heading scope=1:1..1:53 anchor="i-ſ-ß-σ-ς-ⅳ-²-é-a‿b-a⁀b-_-ab-" attributes={} level=1 children=1
    └── Text scope=1:3..1:53 anchor=null attributes={} literal="İ ſ ẞ Σ ς Ⅳ ² é a‿b a⁀b _ A—B 😀" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
    └── Text scope=1:3..1:33 anchor=null attributes={} literal="A\u000b        　B" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## empty and cleared identifiers

```````````````````````````````` example
#

# !!!

# X {#given id=}
.

├── Heading scope=1:1..1:1 anchor="section" attributes={} level=1 children=0
├── Heading scope=3:1..3:5 anchor="section-1" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=3:3..3:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="!!!" children=0
└── Heading scope=5:1..5:16 anchor="x" attributes={} level=1 children=1
    └── Text scope=5:3..5:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="X" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
│   └── Text scope=3:3..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
├── Heading scope=5:1..5:5 anchor="x-1-1" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=5:3..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x-1" children=0
├── Heading scope=7:1..7:3 anchor="x-3" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=7:3..7:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=9:1..9:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1

└── Paragraph scope=11:1..11:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
````````````````````````````````

## source order including footnotes

```````````````````````````````` example
[^f]: # Dup

# Dup

[Dup] [^f]
.
Document scope=1:1..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Heading scope=3:1..3:5 anchor="dup-1" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=3:3..3:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Dup" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Link scope=5:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("#dup") title=null children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=5:2..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Dup" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=5:6..5:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Cite scope=5:7..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=5:8..5:9 referent=footnote(id="f") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:1..2:0 id="f" children=1
    └── Heading scope=1:7..1:11 anchor="dup" attributes={} level=1 children=1
        └── Text scope=1:9..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Dup" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## heading references inside a heading

```````````````````````````````` example
│   │   └── Text scope=1:4..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Next" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:9..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" and " children=0
│   └── Emphasis scope=1:14..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:15..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal="more" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## source label preserves markup and entities

```````````````````````````````` example
# *Straße*

[*STRASSE*] [Straße]

# A &amp; B

[A &amp; B] [A & B]
.
Document scope=1:1..7:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
├── Heading scope=1:1..1:11 anchor="straße" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Emphasis scope=1:3..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:4..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Straße" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Link scope=3:1..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("#straße") title=null children=1
│   │   └── Emphasis scope=3:2..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── Text scope=3:3..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="STRASSE" children=0
│   └── Text scope=3:12..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" [Straße]" children=0
├── Heading scope=5:1..5:11 anchor="a--b" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=5:3..5:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="A & B" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=7:1..7:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Link scope=7:1..7:11 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("#a--b") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=7:2..7:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="A & B" children=0
    └── Text scope=7:12..7:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" [A & B]" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## escaped and forbidden brackets

```````````````````````````````` example
# A\]B

[A\]B] [go][A\]B]

# C]D

[C\]D]
.
Document scope=1:1..7:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
├── Heading scope=1:1..1:6 anchor="ab" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:3..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="A]B" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Link scope=3:1..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("#ab") title=null children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=3:2..3:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="A]B" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=3:7..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Link scope=3:8..3:17 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("#ab") title=null children=1
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
├── Footnote scope=6:1..6:18 id="inline-1" children=2

│       └── Text scope=6:11..6:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Target" children=0
└── Footnote scope=8:1..9:0 id="f" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=8:7..8:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Link scope=8:7..8:14 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("#target") title=null children=1
            └── Text scope=8:8..8:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Target" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Implicit reference in declaration-shaped paragraph text (CI seed 1)

```````````````````````````````` example

****
    <a
*foo _bar* baz_seven-------
.

│   ├── Text scope=2:1..2:31 anchor=null attributes={} literal="three---        with two lines." children=0
│   ├── SoftBreak scope=2:32..2:32 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│   ├── Link scope=3:1..3:5 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("#foo") title=null children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=3:2..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="foo" children=0
│   └── Text scope=3:6..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal=": <>" children=0
├── ThematicBreak scope=4:1..4:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
├── CodeBlock scope=5:5..5:6 anchor=null attributes={} info=null language=null literal="<a\n" fenced=false closed=true children=0

    ├── Emphasis scope=6:1..6:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
````````````````````````````````
